blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines– Carlos Yulo aims to defend his vault title and add to his medal haul when he sees action in the 2026 FIG World Artistic Gymnastics Championships in Rotterdam, Netherlands. Fresh off his double-gold run at the Asian Games 2026, Carlos Yulo returns to the world stage–this time alongside his younger brother, Karl Eldrew–as he leads Team Philippines’ campaign. The World Championships run from October 17 to 25 at Rotterdam Ahoy.
